_none.note: Not a race; odds.py passes over it. No market was found for any of Utah's state races on the November 3, 2026 ballot: the eight State Board of Education seats, the Legislature's seats, or the retention votes on Justice Jill M. Pohlman, the six Court of Appeals judges and the district, juvenile and justice court judges. Utah elects no governor or other statewide executive officer in 2026. Kalshi: its list of every Elections and Politics series (4,512 titles, read 2026-10-03) names for Utah's own offices only a governor series whose events are for 2024 (settled) and 2028, an attorney general series with no events, and a primary series for the U.S. House; its state legislature winner series (28 chambers) has no Utah chamber, and its state supreme court retention series name Wyoming, Kansas and Missouri, not Utah. Left out on purpose: Kalshi's market on whether Republicans hold at least 20 of the 29 seats in the Utah State Senate after November 3 (inside the event "Where will Republicans win state legislative supermajorities in 2026?"), which is about a chamber's make-up, not a contest between people on one ballot. Polymarket: its searches for Utah, the Utah Supreme Court, the State Board of Education, the Legislature and Pohlman, and three likely slugs, returned no event on a Utah state office (2026-10-03); its Utah election events are the U.S. House races, on the Congress pages.
